description: Review finished work against the intent: what the person set out to have done, what must always hold, what was decided. Pass a description, output, message or transcript of what you did; the project intent document is used, or pass intent inline when there is none. Returns a plain summary, what the intent covers, what it does not, and any violations. The Stop hook does this automatically for code changes in a repository; call this for everything else.

intent.description: Inline intent to judge against, used only when the project has no stored intent document

work.description: What was done: a description, the output, a message, or a transcript

name: review_work
